license_required.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry in Missouri without having first secured a license as provided for in this chapter.

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Professional Registration, Department of Commerce and Insurance

moral_character_required.quote: Any person who is of good moral character and reputation, and who is a graduate of and has a degree in dentistry from an accredited dental school may apply to the board for examination and registration as a dentist in Missouri.

degree_required.value: degree in dentistry from an accredited dental school
degree_required.quote: a graduate of and has a degree in dentistry from an accredited dental school

accrediting_body.quote: any college, university, school, or other institution which teaches dentistry which has been certified by the American Dental Association

exams.name: National Board Examination
exams.quote: Completion of the national board theoretical examination with scores acceptable to the board, as promulgated by rule, is a prerequisite to taking the dental examinations.

exams.name: Dental examination
exams.quote: The board shall determine and specify by rule whether the dental examinations shall be written or oral or clinical or all three, but in any event they shall be in such form and of such content and character as to thoroughly test the qualifications of the applicant to practice dentistry in Missouri.

interval_years.quote: Effective with the licensing period beginning on December 1, 2002, a license shall be renewed every two years.

required.quote: To renew a license, each dentist shall submit satisfactory evidence of completion of fifty hours of continuing education during the two-year period immediately preceding the renewal period.

hours_per_period.quote: fifty hours of continuing education during the two-year period

period_years.quote: during the two-year period immediately preceding the renewal period

available.quote: The board shall grant without examination a certificate of registration and a license to a dentist who has been licensed in another state for at least five consecutive years immediately preceding his applying

requirements.value: Licensed in another state for at least five consecutive years; qualifications at least equivalent to Missouri requirements; at least 21 years of age; good moral character and reputation. Board may require examination on Missouri laws and practical examination if licensure was denied, revoked, or suspended for incompetency.
requirements.quote: The board shall grant without examination a certificate of registration and a license to a dentist who has been licensed in another state for at least five consecutive years immediately preceding his applying, if the board is satisfied by proof adduced by the applicant that his qualifications are at least equivalent to the requirements for initial registration as a dentist in Missouri under the provisions of this chapter, that he is at least twenty-one years of age and is of good moral character and reputation

national_association.quote: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry in Missouri without having first secured a license as provided for in this chapter.

credential_type.quote: the board has issued to the person a license, to be renewed each period, as provided in this chapter, to practice dentistry

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry in Missouri without having first secured a license as provided for in this chapter.

title_protection.quote: Uses or permits the use of for the person's benefit or for the benefit of any other person or other entity any card, directory, poster, sign or any other means by which the person indicates or implies or represents that the person is willing or able to perform any type of dental services or operation for any person

scope_protection.quote: A person or other entity 'practices dentistry' within the meaning of this chapter who: (1) Undertakes to do or perform dental work or dental services or dental operations or oral surgery, by any means or methods, including the use of lasers, gratuitously or for a salary or fee or other reward

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substance or alcoholic beverage to an extent that impairs ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any controlled substance, as defined in chapter 195, or alcoholic beverage to an extent that such use impairs a person's ability to perform the work of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for offense reasonably related to qualifications or involving fraud, dishonesty, or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The person has been finally adjudicated and found guilty, or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution pursuant to the laws of any state or of the United States, for any offense reasonably related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated pursuant to this chapter, for any offense an essential element of which is fraud, dishonesty or an act of violence, or any offense involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing license or obtaining permission to take examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing any permit or license issued pursuant to this chapter or in obtaining permission to take any examination given or required pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining fees by fraud, deception or misrepresentation; billing irregularities with third parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee, charge, tuition or other compensation by fraud, deception or misrepresentation; or increasing charges when a patient utilizes a third-party payment program; or for repeated irregularities in billing a third party for services rendered to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetency, misconduct, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation or dishonesty in performance of professional duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetency, misconduct, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation or dishonesty in the performance of, or relating to one's ability to perform, the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of chapter provisions or lawful rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of this chapter, or any lawful rule or regulation adopted pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonation of licensed person or allowing unauthorized use of license or diploma
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonation of any person holding a permit or license or allowing any person to use his or her permit, license or diploma from any school

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by another state, province, territory, federal agency or country on grounds for which discipline is authorized in Missouri
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action against the holder of a license or other right to practice any profession regulated by this chapter imposed by another state, province, territory, federal agency or country upon grounds for which discipline is authorized in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication of incapacity or disability by court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person is finally adjudicated incapacitated or disabled by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting or enabling unlicensed person to practice by lack of supervision or other means
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice, by lack of supervision or in any other manner, any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter who is not registered and currently eligible to practice pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuance of license based upon material mistake of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuance of a permit or license based upon a material mistake of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to display valid certificate, permit or license if required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to display a valid certificate, permit or license if so required by this chapter or by any rule promulgated hereunder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of professional trust or confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any professional trust or confidence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, misleading or deceptive advertisement or solicitation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any advertisement or solicitation that is false, misleading or deceptive to the general public or persons to whom the advertisement or solicitation is primarily directed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of drug laws or rules and regulations of this state, other states, or federal government
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the drug laws or rules and regulations of this state, any other state or the federal government

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to properly guard against contagious, infectious or communicable diseases
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to properly guard against contagious, infectious or communicable diseases or the spread thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain office, laboratory, equipment and instruments in safe and sanitary condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain his or her office or offices, laboratory, equipment and instruments in a safe and sanitary condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting, tendering or paying rebates or splitting fees with other persons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting, tendering or paying rebates to or splitting fees with any other person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering nitrous oxide gas to self or others except as adjunctive measure to patient management
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, or causing or permitting to be administered, nitrous oxide gas in any amount to himself or herself, or to another unless as an adjunctive measure to patient management

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to professional incompetency, illness, drunkenness, excessive drug use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice as a dentist, specialist or hygienist with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reasons of professional incompetency, or because of illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or as a result of any mental or physical condition

definition_quote.value: A person or other entity 'practices dentistry' within the meaning of this chapter who: (1) Undertakes to do or perform dental work or dental services or dental operations or oral surgery, by any means or methods, including the use of lasers, gratuitously or for a salary or fee or other reward, paid directly or indirectly to the person or to any other person or entity; (2) Diagnoses or professes to diagnose, prescribes for or professes to prescribe for, treats or professes to treat, any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury or physical condition of human teeth or adjacent structures or treats or professes to treat any disease or disorder or lesions of the oral regions
definition_quote.quote: A person or other entity 'practices dentistry' within the meaning of this chapter who: (1) Undertakes to do or perform dental work or dental services or dental operations or oral surgery, by any means or methods, including the use of lasers, gratuitously or for a salary or fee or other reward, paid directly or indirectly to the person or to any other person or entity; (2) Diagnoses or professes to diagnose, prescribes for or professes to prescribe for, treats or professes to treat, any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury or physical condition of human teeth or adjacent structures or treats or professes to treat any disease or disorder or lesions of the oral regions

value: diagnosis and treatment of diseases and conditions of teeth and oral regions
removal of deposits and polishing of teeth
construction and placement of prosthetic dentures and bridges
methods_authorized.quote: Undertakes to do or perform dental work or dental services or dental operations or oral surgery, by any means or methods, including the use of lasers

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe, possess, administer, dispense, or distribute controlled substances in the course of professional practice of dentistry with valid federal and state registration, subject to federal and Missouri narcotic drug and controlled substances acts
drug_authority.quote: Any duly registered and currently licensed dentist in Missouri may write, and any pharmacist in Missouri who is currently licensed under the provisions of chapter 338 and any amendments thereto, may fill any prescription of a duly registered and currently licensed dentist in Missouri for any drug necessary or proper in the practice of dentistry, provided that no such prescription is in violation of either the Missouri or federal narcotic drug act.

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: All duly registered and currently licensed dentists in Missouri who prescribe and administer deep sedation or general anesthesia agents in the course of providing dental services shall possess a deep sedation or general anesthesia permit issued by the board. All duly registered and currently licensed dentists in Missouri who prescribe and administer conscious sedation agents in the course of providing dental services shall possess a conscious sedation permit issued by the board.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: Any dental office where deep sedation or general anesthesia or conscious sedation agents are administered shall possess a site certificate issued by the board and comply with the board's minimum standard for site certificates.

specialist_license_available.quote: The board shall upon application issue a specialist's license to any currently licensed dentist in Missouri who has been certified in any specialty by an examining board recognized by the American Dental Association.

value: supervision in public health settings for fluoride treatments, teeth cleaning and sealants
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote:
a dental hygienist shall only practice under the supervision of a dentist who is duly registered and currently licensed in Missouri, except as provided in subsection 2 of this section.
2. A duly registered and currently licensed dental hygienist who has been in practice at least three years and who is practicing in a public health setting may provide fluoride treatments, teeth cleaning and sealants, if appropriate, to children who are eligible for medical assistance, pursuant to chapter 208, without the supervision of a dentist.

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Dentists shall avoid prescribing doses greater than fifty morphine milligram equivalent (MME) per day for treatment of acute pain. If in the professional judgment of the dentist, doses greater than fifty MME are necessary to treat the patient, the dentist shall document and explain in the patient's dental record the reason for the necessity for the dose greater than fifty MME.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Constructs, supplies, reproduces or repairs any prosthetic denture, bridge, artificial restoration, appliance or other structure to be used or worn as a substitute for natural teeth, except when one, not a registered and licensed dentist, does so pursuant to a written uniform laboratory work order, in the form prescribed by the board, of a dentist registered and currently licensed in Missouri

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: On and after January 1, 1988, every complete upper and lower denture and removable dental prosthesis fabricated by a dentist, or fabricated pursuant to his or her prescription, shall be marked with the name or Social Security number, or both, of the patient for whom the prosthesis is intended.

teledentistry_authorized.quote:
Any person or entity not licensed to practice dentistry in Missouri shall not engage in the practice of dentistry, as defined in section 332.171, across state lines except as provided in this section.
2. For purposes of this chapter, the
"practice of dentistry across state lines"
means:
(1) The rendering of any written or otherwise documented dental opinion concerning the diagnosis or treatment of a patient within this state by a dentist located outside this state as a result of transmission of individual patient data by electronic, telephonic, or other means from within this state or any other state to such dentist or dentist's agent

patient_record_retention_years.quote: Patient records remaining under the care, custody and control of the licensees shall be maintained by the licensee, or the licensee's designee, for a minimum of seven years from the date of when the last professional service was provided or in the case of a minor, seven years from the age of majority.
